settings.title: Cellular Environment
settings.text: Reproductive tissues require active cellular maintenance to function properly.

settings.title: The Polyamine Role
settings.text: Spermidine is a natural polyamine that plays a role in the normal process of recycling cellular material.

settings.title: Current Research
settings.text: Animal research is currently investigating how spermidine interacts with cellular stress in reproductive environments.

settings.question: Will this guarantee a bigger load?
settings.answer: No. Ejaculate volume depends on hydration, arousal, and individual biology. While a veterinary study showed fluid increases in heat-stressed rams, a human volume increase from oral capsules remains a hypothesis, not an established outcome.

settings.question: Is this based on human clinical trials?
settings.answer: The semen-volume finding comes from animal research and does not establish a human volume effect. We offer this ingredient in a clearly labeled formulation for those interested in the underlying science.

settings.question: Can I take this with other medications?
settings.answer: Goodwell keeps its active ingredient list simple. However, if you take prescription medications or have existing health conditions, please consult your healthcare provider before starting any new dietary supplement.

settings.question: What exactly is in the capsules?
settings.answer: Each serving of two capsules contains 10mg of Spermidine 3HCL, an HPMC capsule, and rice flour. There are no proprietary blends or hidden herbs.

settings.question: How many capsules should I take?
settings.answer: Take two capsules daily with water. Each bottle contains 60 capsules, providing a complete 30-day supply for one person.

settings.question: Do I have to sign up for a subscription?
settings.answer: No. Every order is a one-time purchase. We do not use auto-billing or hidden subscription plans. You only buy what you actively choose to add to your cart.
